name: Billboard
hook: The music industry's chart bible — home of the Hot 100 and the Billboard 200.

facts.label: the Hot 100
facts.statement: Billboard's Hot 100 chart debuted in the August 4, 1958 issue of the magazine.

facts.label: trade magazine
facts.statement: Billboard is the music-industry trade magazine; Paul Ackerman edited it for 30 years and entered the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame.

facts.label: Mariah Carey
facts.statement: Mariah Carey has more Billboard No. 1 pop hits than any other solo artist — her 18th came in April 2008.

facts.label: Paul McCartney
facts.statement: Paul McCartney has had more Billboard No. 1 hits than any other artist — 29 in all, solo, in duets and with groups.

facts.label: the Billboard 200
facts.statement: Journey's Greatest Hits has spent more than 800 weeks on the Billboard 200, one of only three albums to reach 600 weeks.

facts.label: Billboard Music Awards
facts.statement: At the 1990 Billboard Music Awards, Janet Jackson's album Rhythm Nation 1814 helped her take eight trophies.

facts.label: Drake
facts.statement: In May 2016 Drake set a record by placing 20 songs on Billboard's Hot 100 in a single week.
